name: photo storage
description: MIPT 2026 / photo storage: User-controlled data is concatenated into an OS command executed through a shell instead of being passed as an argument vector. Injection type is Command Injection. Attack surface: web parameters feeding utility endpoints (ping, dns, convert, archive, render) that shell out. Recommended strategy: All database access is parameterised, but the compression handler builds f"convert {input_path} -quality {quality} {output_path}" and runs it with shell=True. The quality field is never validated as an integer, so it carries shell metacharacters straight into the command. The route sits behind the admin panel, so the chain starts with reaching that panel through the upload/auth logic.
vuln_type: Command Injection via the ImageMagick quality parameter (authenticated/admin)
target_tech_stack: Python 3 + Flask + SQLite + Pillow + ImageMagick convert
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves.
